title: AI Governance Lead
description: Role Summary Own the design and execution of the enterprise AI governance program. Build the standards, policies, and procedures that govern how AI use cases and models move from idea to production. Structure the governance roadmap across intake, classification, value assessment, and control design. Stand up use case governance and model governance functions, define the target state for AI governance across the organization, and drive an implementation plan with clear monitoring, prioritized against engineering delivery timelines. Key Responsibilities Governance Framework Design Author and maintain AI governance standards, policies, and procedures covering the full lifecycle of AI use cases and models Design the governance roadmap organized into intake, classification, value assessment, and control design stages Define risk tiers and controls proportional to use case risk (e.g., low/medium/high risk classification tied to required controls) Use Case Governance Build the intake process for new AI use cases: how requests enter the pipeline, what information is captured, who reviews them Establish classification criteria (risk level, data sensitivity, regulatory exposure, business criticality) Design value assessment methodology to prioritize use cases against cost, risk, and business impact Define control requirements per classification tier (documentation, testing, sign-off, monitoring) Model Governance Establish model risk management practices: validation, documentation, versioning, approval gates Define requirements for model cards, testing evidence, bias/fairness checks, and performance monitoring Set standards for third-party and open-source model vetting Target State & Team Build Define the target state for AI governance: what "good" looks like, what the organization should expect from the function Design the governance team structure, roles, and operating model Set RACI across governance, engineering, legal, risk, and business stakeholders Implementation & Monitoring Build a phased implementation plan with milestones and owners Prioritize governance rollout in sequence with engineering platform and architecture delivery Establish monitoring and reporting: KPIs, compliance tracking, exception handling, escalation paths Run periodic reviews of the governance program's effectiveness and adjust as needed Required Qualifications Combined minimum of 10 years' higher education and/or operational/business analytics/systems development experience Demonstrated experience building a governance framework or program from the ground up in a large or complex organization Working knowledge of model risk management practices (e.g., SR 11-7 or equivalent) and how they extend to AI/ML systems Experience designing intake, classification, and risk assessment processes for technology or data initiatives Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, legal, compliance, and business teams Strong written communication skills; able to produce policy documents, standards, and executive-level reporting Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (risk, business, computer science, law, or similar); advanced degree a plus but not required in place of experience Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with AI-specific regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and applying them practically Prior experience standing up or scaling a governance team, including hiring and role design Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment pipelines, enough to design controls that don't bottleneck engineering Experience with generative AI governance specifically (prompt/data leakage risk, hallucination controls, third-party LLM vendor risk) Certifications such as CRISC, CISA, or AI governance-specific credentials Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, insurance) Skills Required Policy and standards writing Risk classification and control design Stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences Program/project management (roadmap building, milestone tracking, prioritization) Working knowledge of ML lifecycle and model development practices Data literacy: able to read model documentation, validation reports, and technical risk assessments Facilitation and negotiation, particularly balancing governance rigor against engineering velocity #LI-JB3 M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $123,600.00 - $206,000.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. Location Buffalo, New York, United States of America

title: Lead Accountant - Order to Cash
description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us! Your Opportunity In this role, you will serve as the operational bridge connecting financial strategy with global execution. Operating as the primary liaison between Revenue/Finance leadership and the Accounts Receivable (AR) Operations team, you will drive month-end close acceleration and establish governance across global workflows and projects. You will coordinate the end-to-end transformation in Order-to-Cash (OTC) by embedding AI automation, predictive risk engines, and standardized operations into our daily financial reporting cadence. What You'll Do 1. Global Operational Liaison Project Management: Standardize and accelerate the project timeline, ensuring seamless coordination between cross-functional teams and pushing the projects to closures. SOP Standardization: Document and maintain formal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all AR workflows, establishing and designing strict human-in-the-loop validation steps to safeguard financial controls. 2. AI Automation & Process Innovation E2E AI Transformation: Act as the operational lead for implementing agentic and non-agentic automation. Predictive AI Risk Models: Partner with technical teams to deploy the Predictive Account Risk Engine, utilizing billing and consumption telemetry to automatically prioritize collections outreach. Workforce Scaling: Leverage Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and automated exception-handling tools to streamline repetitive tasks (such as payment auto-matching in HighRadius), allowing the global operations team to scale efficiently. 3. Advanced AR Reporting & Analytics Executive Visibility: Translate complex AR aging, Collections Efficiency Index (CEI), and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) metrics into high-level liquidity forecasts and risk assessments for leadership. Act as the primary, real-time liaison between the Revenue/Finance leadership team and the AR Operations team to align on data points. This Role Requires Accounting & Systems Experience: 5+ years of progressive OTC/AR/FP&A experience in SaaS or technology sectors, with hands-on proficiency in NetSuite, BillingPlatform, Zuora, and HighRadius. Global Operations & Data Capabilities: Proven track record of coordinating cross-regional teams, analyzing complex financial data, and building structured variance reports. Leadership & Compliance: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Finance, Sales, and Legal, with experience leading teams through process changes in SOX-compliant environments. Bonus Points If You Have Automation Mindset: Experience implementing financial process improvements, such as robotic process automation (RPA), auto-match logic, or OCR/Intelligent Document Processing (IDP). Responsible AI Governance: Familiarity with corporate compliance guardrails for utilizing Generative AI (e.g., Enterprise Gemini, Claude, etc.) in financial workflows, including data security protocols (PII/MNPI masking). Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI- KM1  #LI- remote The pay range below represents a reasonable estimate of the salary for the listed position. This role is eligible for a corporate bonus plan. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related factors such as an applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience. New Relic provides a variety of benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, parental leave and planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, flex time-off, 11 paid holidays, volunteer time-off, and other competitive benefits designed to improve the lives of our employees. Estimated Base Pay Range $118,000 — $147,000 USD Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com . We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist / Data Governance Consultant
description: Für unseren Kunden aus dem Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld suchen wir eine erfahrene Fachperson im Bereich AI Governance mit ergänzender Expertise in Data Governance und Data Quality. In dieser Rolle unterstützt du das Team Data & AI Governance bei der konzeptionellen und operativen Weiterentwicklung sowie der Umsetzung von Governance-Vorgaben für den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Operationalisierung von AI Governance, der Weiterentwicklung von Governance-Anforderungen für Agentic AI sowie der Implementierung geeigneter Governance-Prozesse und Tools. Ergänzend wirkst du an strategischen Initiativen im Bereich Data Governance und Data Quality mit. Unterstützung des AI Governance Officers bei der Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Operationalisierung der AI Governance Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Governance-Anforderungen für Agentic AI und autonome KI-Systeme Mitarbeit bei der Evaluation, Einführung und Implementierung eines AI Governance Tools Analyse, Optimierung und Operationalisierung bestehender AI-Governance-Prozesse Erstellung und Finalisierung von Governance-Konzepten, Richtlinien, Weisungen und weiteren Governance-Artefakten Unterstützung beim Aufbau von Post-Deployment-Monitoring-Prozessen für KI-Systeme Sicherstellung einer strukturierten Zusammenarbeit mit Risk Management, Legal, Information Security und Enterprise Architecture Ergänzende Aufgaben: Data Governance & Data Quality Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Operationalisierung von Data-Governance- und Data-Quality-Management-Prozessen Mitwirkung beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Knowledge-Management-Konzepten Konzeptionelle Unterstützung beim Management kritischer Daten Mitarbeit bei der Evaluation und fachlichen Beurteilung von Data-Quality-Tools Erarbeitung und Dokumentation strategischer und operativer Governance-Konzepte Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in AI Governance, Data Governance oder Data Management Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Implementierung von Governance-Frameworks, Richtlinien, Prozessen und Zielbildern Fundiertes Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen und des Risikomanagements im Daten- und KI-Umfeld Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens mehreren der folgenden Themen: AI Lifecycle Management AI Risk Management & Responsible AI Agentic AI Governance AI Governance Frameworks und Controls Data Governance & Data Quality Management Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Risk-, Legal-, Security- und Architektur-Teams Erfahrung in der Finanzbranche oder anderen regulierten Branchen von Vorteil Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Counsel - Product & Privacy
description: About the Role Together AI is looking for a Senior Counsel to help build the legal and compliance foundation behind our AI infrastructure and the products our customers depend on. You’ll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Infrastructure, and Sales as the legal partner who helps each team move quickly while keeping risk in view. This role suits a lawyer who wants to build programs in product, privacy, export controls, and patent and licensing strategy, and who is curious enough about inference, fine-tuning, and GPU infrastructure to give advice grounded in how the technology works. Responsibilities Product  Partner with Product and Engineering early in the lifecycle to shape new inference, fine-tuning, GPU cluster, and platform offerings with legal considerations built in. Draft and maintain customer-facing product terms. Advise on legal issues unique to AI infrastructure: model hosting and third-party model licenses, data use and ownership, and shared responsibility between platform and customer. Build playbooks, templates, and self-serve tools that let the business move fast without legal becoming a bottleneck. Advise on open-source and model licensing (open-weight models, permissive and restrictive licenses, community licenses). Help build and run our patent program: invention disclosure processes, working with Research and Engineering on patentable innovations, managing outside patent counsel, and aligning filing strategy with business priorities. Privacy Own and evolve our global privacy program across GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and other US state laws, and emerging regimes in APAC and elsewhere. Lead privacy-by-design reviews for new products and features, including those involving model inputs, outputs, logging, and retention. Manage DPAs, subprocessor processes, cross-border data transfer mechanisms, and DPIAs. Track developments in privacy and AI regulation, including the EU AI Act, and translate them into practical guidance for the business. Compliance & Export Controls Build and operate an export controls and sanctions compliance program suited to a company handling advanced compute and AI technologies. Advise on EAR, OFAC, and related regimes as they apply to GPU access, cloud services, model weights, and customer onboarding, including restricted-party screening, geographic and end-use restrictions, and license determinations. Develop policies, training, controls, and monitoring in partnership with Finance, Security, Sales, and Infrastructure teams. Requirements A JD and an active bar license in good standing 7+ years of experience at a top law firm and/or in-house at a technology company, ideally cloud, infrastructure, semiconductors, SaaS, or AI. Demonstrated experience advising product and engineering teams and drafting product terms. Hands-on experience with global privacy law and running or substantially contributing to a privacy program. Working knowledge of export controls (EAR/OFAC), ideally including building or scaling a compliance program. Experience with technology and IP licensing, including open-source licenses. Strong judgment, a pragmatic risk-based approach, and the ability to give clear, business-oriented advice. A plain-spoken style that makes legal and technical points accessible to non-lawyers Comfort working independently in a small, fast-moving legal team, with sound instincts for what to own, what to escalate, and when to bring in specialized outside counsel Desire for learning and building with AI tools so you can operate self-sufficiently and at speed Preferred Experience at a high-growth startup or scaling a legal function from early stage. Familiarity with AI/ML legal issues, such as model licensing, training data, AI regulation, and responsible use. Technical fluency, with comfort discussing GPUs, inference systems, APIs, and cloud architecture. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM) About Together AI Together AI is a research-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancement such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers and engineers in our journey in building the next generation AI infrastructure. Compensation We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $245-275K + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. Equal Opportunity Togethe
